name: Break & hold (follow) at equal highs / lows of the last 2 hours — price only (reference)
why: A first 5-minute close beyond equal highs / lows of the last 2 hours with aggressive flow behind it is real demand running the stops parked there; the triggered stops add fuel in the same direction. Pre-registered 2026-10-16 (research/preregistered/2026-10-16_liquidity_boxes_all.md). Reference run without the delta condition, 2010-26.
